_README: ONE canonical observation, SELECTed out of Group 1's VANA-schema.sql after ingesting the Group 3 field fixture through it. Every value in 'canonical_observation' was read from the database. This is Group 1's SCHEMA, not Group 1's INSTANCE - see _honesty.

_honesty.canonical_store: LOCAL - Group 1 schema v0.1 applied to PostgreSQL 16 / PostGIS
_honesty.note: No Group 3 sensor has produced a recorded reading. Values are illustrative and exist to prove the system path, not hardware readiness. Do not treat this as real field data.

dataset.methodology: Drone aerial survey per Group 3 Field Mission SOP

provenance.derivation_note: Field capture by device G3-LIDAR-001; raw artifact TC-Z03-F02/drone/pointcloud_F02_001.las

group4_handoff.trace_id_status: NULL on this record, and correctly so. CANONICAL FORMAT is 'VANA-<12 lowercase hex>' (e.g. VANA-3a9fd87b337d), per the Group 1 VANA MasterDB Observation API v1.0.0 handoff, which returns trace_id in every ingestion, replay, conflict and duplicate response. Group 3 does NOT mint traces - it emits null and receives one back on ingestion. The trace becomes non-null only after this observation has been submitted.
group4_handoff.identity_rule: Identity is the whole tuple: Survey + Zone + Flight + Sensor + Observation seq, PLUS coordinates and timestamp. The OBS### fragment is NOT unique on its own - it repeats every flight.

group4_handoff.idempotency: Re-submitting the identical package left observation count at 3. Enforced by ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING on the natural key.
